name: FA_METHODS_
description: FA_METHODS contains information on depreciation methods. The depreciation program uses this table to identify the appropriate depreciation rates for table based methods in FA_RATES.

columns.name: METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Name of the depreciation method.

columns.name: LIFE_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Life in months for the investment tax credit.

columns.name: DEPRECIATE_LASTYEAR_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether to depreciate assets in the last year of life.

columns.name: STL_METHOD_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies a straight line depreciation method.

columns.name: RATE_SOURCE_RULE
columns.description: The depreciation rate source. Possible values are CALCULATED, FLAT, PRODUCTION, FORMULA, or TABLE.

columns.name: DEPRN_BASIS_RULE
columns.description: Depreciation calculation basis. It can be based on cost or net book value.

columns.name: PRORATE_PERIODS_PER_YEAR
columns.description: Number of prorate periods for table based methods.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the depreciation method.

columns.name: EXCLUDE_SALVAGE_VALUE_FLAG
columns.description: Option to exclude the salvage value when calculating the depreciable basis.

columns.name: DEPRN_BASIS_RULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation basis rule.

columns.name: POLISH_ADJ_CALC_BASIS_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether a negative adjustment on an asset using a Polish depreciation basis rule should be subject to special depreciation basis rules.

columns.name: SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies a set of reference data shared across business units and other entities. Also known as Reference Data Sets, they are used to filter reference data in transactional UIs.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
